[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-y5[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Subscription capacity for Claude, Codex, and Grok[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Let subscription users inspect remaining provider allowances, their[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]scope, resets, and freshness through an extensible shared backend, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]CLI, and responsive ACE experience.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]subscription_capacity.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/subscription_capacity.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-y5[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-y5/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Define the shared subscription capacity model[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]capacity-domain[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capacity-domain: Implement the Rust observation and public read [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contracts, validation, freshness, scope applicability, and summary rules[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]specified in this plan, with deterministic fixtures and PyO3 coverage. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]No collection or UI.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Persist observations and fence stale writers[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]capacity-store[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capacity-domain[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capacity-store: Add the machine-local Rust store, account-generation [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fencing, complete-versus-partial merges, bounded atomic persistence, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]read-only loading, and thin Python facade. Coordinate the required core [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wheel and SASE dependency.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add the provider extension and bounded probe runtime[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]probe-runtime[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capacity-store[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]probe-runtime: Add optional dynamic usage hooks, typed probe [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contexts/results, process isolation and deadline handling, usage [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]configuration, synthetic plugin fixtures, and the temporary epic beta [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]flag. Preserve existing plugin behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Collect Claude subscription windows and passive updates[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]claude-usage[dim] · [dim][/dim]after probe-runtime[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]claude-usage: Implement the zero-inference Claude usage probe and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]supplementary rate_limit_event capture, account-mode detection, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]conservative date parsing, per-window merges, and noninterference tests [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]for normal stream parsing.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Collect Codex subscription windows through app-server[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]codex-usage[dim] · [dim][/dim]after probe-runtime[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]codex-usage: Implement bounded app-server initialization, account/read [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and account/rateLimits/read collection, multi-bucket normalization, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capability degradation, account fencing, and protocol/process-cleanup [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Collect Grok subscription allowance through ACP[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]grok-usage[dim] · [dim][/dim]after probe-runtime[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grok-usage: Implement the Grok Build ACP billing extension collector, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]native percentage and verified legacy decoding, account-wide scope, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]honest unsupported and not-applicable states, and bounded process [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cleanup with fixture coverage.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Supervise and coalesce refreshes across clients[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]usage-refresh[dim] · [dim][/dim]after probe-runtime[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]usage-refresh: Implement the shared durable refresh service, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-provider admission and receipts, deadlines, cadence/backoff, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scheduled collection, and best-effort limit/reset triggers. Verify [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]overlapping requests and crash recovery.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Expose cached usage and explicit refresh in the CLI[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]usage-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after usage-refresh[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]usage-cli: Add sase usage list and refresh, a stable JSON contract, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plain/Rich presentation, provider filters, precise exit behavior, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]completion/help, and offline doctor diagnostics. Build the shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]presentation helpers for ACE.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add a read-only Usage view to the Providers home[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]providers-usage-ui[dim] · [dim][/dim]after usage-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]providers-usage-ui: Evolve the provider modal into a shared Providers [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]home with Usage and Routing views, cached first paint, durable update [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]observation, all allowance details, discoverable navigation, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keyboard/PNG regression tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Show scoped capacity hints where users choose providers[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]usage-context[dim] · [dim][/dim]after providers-usage-ui[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]usage-context: Add model and alias-member capacity hints and merge quiet[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]usage attention into the existing provider indicator. Preserve routing, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]advisories, selection behavior, and responsiveness; verify narrow and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monochrome layouts.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  11 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify the combined feature and remove epic scaffolding[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]usage-release[dim] · [dim][/dim]after claude-usage, codex-usage, grok-usage, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]usage-context[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]usage-release: Integrate all collectors and surfaces, run adversarial [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]end-to-end and performance checks, finalize documentation and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]compatibility evidence, remove the temporary beta flag, and pass [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monitored full verification before landing.[/#D7D7AF]

commits.subject: feat(ace): add Providers · Usage view to Models panel
feat(llm): add subscription usage probe runtime and beta flag
